Message:
[SCSI] advansys: Improve reset handler

 - Don't need to set ASC_HOST_IN_RESET any more
 - Don't need to test scp->device->host for NULL -- if it's NULL, we
   couldn't've been called.
 - Use scmd_printk instead of ASC_PRINT
